definition: The selected Square Enix Nintendo Switch digital release of Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven, released 24 October 2024, is described as a full 3D remake of the original 1993 RPG.
cultural_caution: An exact version/platform/localization witness only; it does not merge original, earlier remaster, later Switch 2 Edition, or other platform content.

citations.locator: Save Your Empire. Defend Your Legacy; About this item
supports: Nintendo identifies the full-3D-remake relationship and selected Switch release date/platform/language scope.

definition: The seven legendary warriors who once fought to save humankind, were banished by the Ancients, returned in corrupted forms, and command forces opposed by the Empire.
cultural_caution: A source-specific named affiliation and legend, not a generic hero class or a claim about a real religious or historical tradition.

supports: Publisher description gives the Seven Heroes' rescue, banishment, corrupted return, and vengeance premise.

definition: A system in which the player chooses successive Emperors and earlier rulers' knowledge and abilities pass to the next through inheritance magic.
cultural_caution: A player-driven succession mechanic, not one immutable imperial genealogy or proof that every possible Emperor shares the same biography, party, legacy, death, or ending.

supports: Nintendo describes selectable Emperors and knowledge/ability transfer through inheritance magic.
Square Enix describes succession triggers and partial ability inheritance.

definition: The remake's choice- and objective-order-responsive structure, in which empire expansion and the order of confronting Seven Heroes alter the Emperor's journey.
cultural_caution: A branching play structure. Territory, quest order, recruitments, victories, defeats, time passage, and endings are not universal facts for a person or continuity.

supports: Nintendo describes narrative responses to choices, objectives, empire expansion, and Seven-Hero challenge order.

definition: The remake's combat mechanics: learning abilities in battle through Glimmers, composition-based Formation effects, and retinue combination attacks called United Attacks.
cultural_caution: These are mechanics and party-state effects, not innate attributes to assign universally to every named person or class.

supports: Nintendo describes Glimmers, Formations, United Attacks, and timeline combat.

canonical_term: demo, bonus DLC, update, and later-version boundary
original_script: 無料体験版・特典装飾品セット
literal_gloss: Free trial version / bonus accessory set
definition: Square Enix separately identifies a transferable opening demo, bonus accessory items, a later music update, and a later Nintendo Switch 2 Edition; Nintendo separately lists a Bonus Accessory Set DLC.
cultural_caution: Demo progress, optional bonus items, updates, DLC, and later-version features are separate product states and do not establish base-game character abilities, story outcomes, or canonical equipment.

citations.locator: Announcements and Nintendo Switch 2 Edition information
supports: Square Enix records the transferable demo, update, and later Switch 2 Edition boundary.
Nintendo lists a separate Bonus Accessory Set DLC.

definition: Square Enix describes the remake as a full remake of the second Romancing SaGa game and says it has no direct story connection to the preceding Romancing SaGa, so it can be played independently.
cultural_caution: Franchise membership does not license transferring characters, worlds, species, mechanics, histories, or endings across SaGa titles, remakes, remasters, localizations, or anthology packages.

supports: Square Enix calls the work a full remake of the 1993 game, second after Romancing SaGa, with no direct story connection to the preceding title.
